findings.title: File Browser 'open in tab N' on the already displayed file never refreshes the badge or page
findings.evidence: openInTab handler only calls updateTab and setActiveTabId; pageKey is unchanged for an unchanged file in the active tab, so no re-fetch. Live repro: badge stayed 'Modified 2026-04-01 00:00:00' after the file was touched to 2026-04-05 and viewerBridge.get().openInTab(1, sameFile) was called. Dropdown re-select, Refresh and tab round trip do advance it.
findings.consequence: REQ-012 R04 (re-selecting a changed file shows the newer time) holds on only one of two selection paths; the badge shows a stale time after 'open in tab' of a regenerated file.
findings.minimal_fix: In the openInTab bridge handler, when the target tab already shows that file, call setRefreshToken((v) => v + 1); add a vitest case for openInTab on the displayed file with a changed mock mtime.

findings.title: Header still clips the Embedded toggle at layout-2 primary 1024x768; live fit check does not render the badge
findings.evidence: Live REQ-037 check still reports wrap (324px in 307px) and silent-clip findings; toggle spans x 606.5-682.6 while the section ends at 666.7, screenshot shows 'Embedde'. Inline flexWrap on the header cannot shrink the non-wrapping .stage-html-viewer__controls item. Header height grows 40->63, 54->63 and 54->77 in several cells. The fit check seeds selected_file null so the badge is never rendered.
findings.consequence: Toggle partly unreachable at a named layout/size; extra 23px header row in 4 of 8 cells; the live check cannot see the badge's effect.
findings.minimal_fix: Add flex-wrap to .stage-html-viewer__controls and move the inline styles to StagePage.css (needs a deliverables amendment), or record the clip as an acknowledged pre-existing finding; seed the fit check with a selected file.

findings.title: _modified_at raises ValueError/OverflowError on out-of-range mtimes, failing the whole listing
findings.evidence: Only OSError around stat() is caught; datetime.fromtimestamp is outside the try. Patching Path.stat to st_mtime=3e11 gives 'ValueError year 11476 is out of range'. Docstring promises None whenever the time cannot be reported.
findings.consequence: One file with a far-future or corrupt mtime (possible on NTFS/XFS/btrfs, Windows paths exist) makes /workbench/list and /workbench/search return HTTP 500 for the whole directory, breaking the File Browser and pickers that do not use the field.
findings.minimal_fix: Move fromtimestamp into the try and catch (OSError, OverflowError, ValueError); add a test with a huge st_mtime expecting None.

findings.title: Pending state untested; local time shown without a timezone label
findings.evidence: No vitest case asserts 'Modified …' while the list read is pending (only verified live with a delayed route). Visible text 'Modified 2026-03-01 05:00:00' has no zone label while the title is UTC. The mtime is read concurrently with the page HEAD check, not the iframe load.
findings.consequence: A regression that shows the previous file's time during a pending read would pass the tests; the visible time can be misread against the UTC title.
findings.minimal_fix: Add a vitest case with a deferred list response asserting 'Modified …'; append a zone indicator to the visible text.
